summary: Iteration 6 testing complete: WebSocket integration (use-socket.js hook), Commissioner Tools page, and Player Detail page. All 26 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend features verified working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: WebSocket hook (use-socket.js) correctly implements Socket.IO connection with room management
useDraftSocket and useLeagueSocket hooks provide clean abstractions for draft and league events
DraftRoomPage uses useDraftSocket instead of 5s polling - now has 30s fallback polling
CommissionerPage correctly filters leagues where user is commissioner_id
CommissionerPage has all 4 tabs: Season Management, Waivers, Trades, Teams
CommissionerPage overview cards show Teams, Pending Claims, Pending Trades, Current Week
PlayerDetailPage shows full stats breakdown with progress bars for skaters and goalies
PlayerDetailPage correctly calculates fantasy points (Goals*3 + Assists*2 + Plus/Minus)
Sidebar has Commissioner link in MANAGEMENT section
All data-testid attributes present for testing
seed_data_creation: Used existing test data from previous iterations
context_for_next_testing_agent:
Iteration 6 adds:

1. WEBSOCKET INTEGRATION:
- /app/frontend/src/hooks/use-socket.js - Socket.IO hook with useDraftSocket and useLeagueSocket
- DraftRoomPage uses useDraftSocket for real-time draft events (picks, chat, timer)
- Polling reduced from 5s to 30s fallback
- Events: draft_started, draft_pick, draft_chat, draft_timer_toggle, draft_config_updated, draft_completed

2. COMMISSIONER PAGE (/commissioner):
- Overview cards: Teams count, Pending Claims, Pending Trades, Current Week
- Season Management tab: Generate 18-Week Schedule, Simulate Week buttons
- Waivers tab: Pending claims table with Process All button
- Trades tab: Pending trades with Veto button
- Teams tab: League teams table with W/L/T records
- League Settings display: Format, Scoring, Draft Type, Roster Spots, Entry Fee, Salary Cap, Privacy, Status
- League selector dropdown for users with multiple commissioner leagues

3. PLAYER DETAIL PAGE (/players/:id):
- Player header: Name, Position badge, Team, NHL ID, Shoots
- Fantasy Points calculation displayed
- Key stat cards: Goals, Assists, Points, +/-, GP (skaters) or Wins, Save%, GAA, Shutouts (goalies)
- Offense section with progress bars
- Special Teams & Advanced section with progress bars
- Navigation from Players table row click

4. SIDEBAR UPDATE:
- Commissioner link added to MANAGEMENT section

All existing features continue to work.
